opening.argument: The presentation ties income directly to joining a named person's network, displaying 34 partners, a team of 2,184, claimed profits of 20,329.3 BUSD, and an overlay stating that joining 34 people generated 1.6263 million. This is reinforced by the celebratory title describing “working and non-working income” and by a sign-up button, personal link, and phone-number contact for direct participation. Those features promote a recruitment-based opportunity with tiered team growth and income claims, rather than merely discussing or criticizing such a scheme. The combined presentation therefore establishes the recruitment commission mechanism at the center of the offer.
